CobblemonGen1 Builder

Builds the external Pokémon asset pack for Cobblemon 151.

Imports Pokémon #001–493; imports #001–493; Gen1 battle + expanded-dex-ready overworld with their models, textures, rigs and animations.

Select the Cobblemon 1.8.1 EXTRACT_ME.zip and CCC_2.1.zip, then press Build.

The builder will create:

Cobblemon493Pack.zip — contains the Pokémon models, textures, rigs and animations.

CobblemonGen1.zip — the Gen1Recomp mod that loads and uses the external Pokémon pack.

Use the two generated files together.

Source / rights notice: Required source packages are selected by you and processed locally in this browser. Generated packs can contain converted material from those files; generating a pack does not grant redistribution rights. Follow the licenses/terms that apply to your source files.
